summary: No installer-harm behavior observed in animatecss-tailwind-graphic 2.0.6
details: The package's shipped contents show no install-time or import-time behavior that would harm the installer. No lifecycle scripts fetching or executing remote content were observed, no reads of installer credential paths (~/.aws, ~/.ssh, ~/.npmrc, browser stores), no environment-variable scraping, no hardcoded attacker-controlled network destinations, no obfuscated payloads, and no persistence or backdoor mechanisms. The package appears to be a benign Tailwind/Animate.css-related utility with no supply-chain attack surface identified in this version.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
